notes.block: Devanagari, U+0900-U+097F. Words are runs of these letters and signs.
notes.notWord: Danda, double danda, digits ०-९ and the abbreviation sign are not word letters.
notes.replace: The normal form is NFC with every ZWJ and ZWNJ dropped (no "joiners" field), and the first two entries drop them before NFC as well, so Marathi's eyelash ra (र + virama + ZWJ) becomes a plain र्. Mis-encoded independent vowels (अ + sign) are mended, among them अ + ॅ for ॲ (अॅलोपॅथिक), and ा + ॅ for ॉ (डाॅ).
notes.phraseBreaks: The danda । and double danda ॥ end a sentence.
notes.signs: A vowel sign or virama must follow a consonant or nukta. Anusvara, candrabindu and visarga may follow a vowel and are not in this list.
